items.text: If healthy, Geno Smith will start. Glenn pushes back on the idea of starting Klubnik for evaluation purposes: "Come on now."
items.signal: Expected to start if healthy; remains QB1
items.newStatus: If healthy, will start; no rookie evaluation start
items.why: Jets beat reporter relays HC Aaron Glenn's comments that Geno Smith remains the starter if healthy and dismisses starting a rookie for evaluation.
items.implication: JD's starting QB Geno Smith is expected to play barring health issues; Jets not looking to pivot.
items.opportunity: Confirms role; monitor practice participation for any limitation.

items.text: The #Patriots are expected to explore the QB market during the bye week, from free agents such as Jimmy Garoppolo, who has previously played for OC Josh McDaniels, to potentially adding a QB off another team’s practice squad. Tommy DeVito is currently expected to become the starter.
items.signal: Extended absence through bye; DeVito expected starter; exploring QB options
items.priorStatus: Fractured ankle concern, out indefinitely if not for season
items.newStatus: Expected to miss time coming out of bye; DeVito currently expected to start
items.why: Schultz reports Patriots exploring QB market on bye with DeVito expected starter. Corroborated by Rapoport/Vrabel: no definitive diagnosis until return from Germany, would not imagine available coming out of the bye.
items.implication: NE offense without Maye for at least the immediate post-bye window; backfield opportunity (Corey Kiner) remains elevated while QB situation unstable.
items.opportunity: Further strengthens Corey Kiner as waiver target if Stevenson/Henderson remain limited; monitor NE RB usage and any additional QB moves.
corroboration: Ian Rapoport (@RapSheet): Mike Vrabel said he'll avoid any definitive diagnosis on Drake Maye until he returns from Germany (he's en route now). "I wouldn't imagine he'd be available coming out of the bye."

RotoWire NFL: Head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he had no updated diagnosis for Drake Maye (ankle), though he confirmed that the quarterback is expected to miss time. "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the [Week 11] bye."
